# Crypto Airdrop AI (cryptoairdropai.com)

> The premier independent, non-custodial Web3 market intelligence portal tracking, fact-checking, and vetting crypto token airdrops, testnet farming playbooks, and on-chain intelligence across 50+ blockchains.

## Core Mandate & Trust Architecture
- **Non-Custodial Guarantee**: Zero private key or recovery phrase solicitations. 100% read-only on-chain telemetry.
- **5-Stage Contract Audit Standard**: Rigorous bytecode analysis, multisig timelock verification, treasury backing assessments, and tokenomics emission checks.
- **Strict Editorial Independence**: 100% unsponsored protocol evaluations with zero paid token allocations accepted from featured crypto teams.
- **Sybil Resistance Architecture**: Behavioral hygiene playbooks modeled to safeguard authentic users against automated graph clustering and heuristic disqualifications.
